## Summary
Donia Amer builds (and occasionally designs) things for the web. Recent work includes Wattpad's web app (Remix/React), Crypto Unicorns at Laguna Games, Codez (Telegram Mini App with the Doodles team), and the USG Partner App at AppCentrica. Alongside engineering she designs brand identities and social content for small shops and founders.
